note: The held text is an excerpt (front matter, recommendations and part of chapter 1). It names no civil registration system: the OECD recommends digitising the civil-status register, in line with efforts it says were under way at the Direction Générale des Pouvoirs Locaux, and reports stakeholders at its 2016 peer-review missions saying that in most Moroccan cities important registers and archives remained on paper, without saying which registers.
